subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly to Shanghai and drive to the Maoshan Onsen Valley, staying at the 5-star Holiday Inn Resort and Spa with a private in-room onsen from geothermal water. Visit Wuxi’s Lihu and Huishan Ancient Town, Zhujiajiao and Panlong Tiandi, then enjoy a free day in Shanghai. Meals include local specialties and an all-you-can-eat hairy crab.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 3–7 2026 to Dec 3–7 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Maoshan Onsen Valley: A hot-spring resort area near Changzhou where the hotel rooms have private natural onsen baths.
placeDesc.Lihu Scenic Area: A scenic lakeside park in Wuxi with gardens that change with the seasons.
placeDesc.Huishan Ancient Town: A historic old town in Wuxi, rated national 5A and called an open-air history museum.
placeDesc.Nanchang Street: A historic and cultural district along the Grand Canal in Wuxi, part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
placeDesc.Wuxi Purple Clay Museum: A museum in Wuxi on Yixing purple clay teapots and the craft behind them.
placeDesc.Zhujiajiao Ancient Town: A canal town on the edge of Shanghai with stone bridges, old lanes and wooden boats.
placeDesc.Panlong Tiandi: A new cultural and tourism district in Shanghai visited on the way into the city.
placeDesc.Florentia Village Outlet: A European-style outlet shopping village near Shanghai, visited before the flight home.
placeDesc.Jin Mao Tower: A skyscraper in Pudong whose 88th-floor sightseeing hall is part of an optional tour.
placeDesc.Huangpu River: Shanghai's main river, with an optional cruise on the free day.
